description_en: Changes the acceleration region for an accelerated domain name
description_zh: 调用ModifyCdnDomainSchdmByProperty通过配置组修改域名的加速区域
kebab_example: aliyun cdn modify-cdn-domain-schdm-by-property --domain-name example.com --property coverage_:_overseas --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCdnDomainSchdmByProperty

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name for which you want to change the acceleration region. You can specify only one domain name
parameters.help_zh: 需修改加速区域的域名，仅支持单个域名进行修改
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The information about the acceleration region. {"coverage":"overseas"}

Valid values for coverage:

domestic: Chinese mainland

overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland)

global: global
parameters.help_zh:
加速区域属性

{"coverage":"overseas"} 

其中coverage参数的取值如下：

domestic：仅中国内地。
overseas：全球（不含中国内地）。
global：全球
parameters.name: property
